question: Where is the fullness of the eternal kula wheel held to occur?
premises: Fullness of the eternal kula wheel is located somewhere.
One opinion places it on the last bright day of Magha.
That day is called kula parvan.
inference: One opinion identifies the last bright day of Magha as the kula parvan of fullness.
uncertainties: The competing opinions are not fully enumerated.
plain_english: The fullness of the eternal kula wheel is, in one opinion, on the last bright day of Magha, called kula parvan.
